system.description:
Word on the street is known to you. Even without local contacts you know the communities and gangs of a town, recognize tagging and territorial markers, and read the signs, colors and clothes of street people, gangbangers, criminals and social workers.

Use Streetwise with your Mental Traits to recognize the influence of gangs and criminal organizations, or to try a little larceny yourself. An appropriate Social Challenge can smooth dealings with a hostile gang, though Etiquette may be needed for a truly good impression.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Character Creation and Traits
